name: AI SEO Masterclass - Module 2 AI SEO GEO Complete System
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Module 2 explains how AI search differs from Google and lays out the author's 7-step GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) framework plus a content template built for citation.

# Traditional vs AI search (per the lesson)
| Traditional | AI search |
|---|---|
| Shows links, users click | Generates answers, users may not click |
| DR/DA and links dominate | Context, structure and citations dominate |
| Freshness moderate | Freshness massive |

# Platform notes
- **ChatGPT:** 3 to 8 sources per answer, heavy recency bias, loves "Best X" lists, cites Reddit and structured blogs.
- **Google AI Overviews:** 3 to 5 sources, favors Reddit/forums and trusted sources, correlates with featured snippets and People Also Ask.
- **Perplexity:** 5 to 10 sources, research-style, rewards statistics and original data.
- **Copilot:** Bing based, LinkedIn and B2B leaning.
- **Gemini:** tied to Google properties; complete Google Business Profile and YouTube help.

# What gets cited (Ahrefs data as quoted)
Best X listicles 43.8%, comparisons 18.2%, how-to guides 15.7%, research/data 12.4%, product pages 9.9%. Thin, gated, outdated or unstructured pages are ignored.

# The 7-step GEO framework
1. Topic selection (queries people ask AI, decision intent, "best / vs / how to / alternatives / review").
2. Content structure (ranked list, pros/cons, best for, pricing, comparison table, 8 to 12 FAQs).
3. Placement strategy (put your own brand #1 with the longest section, include genuine competitors).
4. Freshness (monthly updates, year in title, visible "Last updated").
5. Schema (Article, FAQPage, HowTo, Product, Review; validate in Rich Results Test).
6. Distribution (own domain first, then Medium/LinkedIn syndication and citations).
7. Monitoring (citation tracking, GA4 AI referrals, query testing).

# Advanced tactics
Multi-LLM testing, citation velocity across a topic cluster, semantic clusters (pillar plus supporting posts all interlinked), credibility signals (bylines, About, contact info, reviews), AI-friendly formatting (2 to 3 sentence paragraphs, bullets, direct answers). Pro tip claims: monthly-updated pieces got 2.3x more citations; FAQPage schema is the highest-ROI schema.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- The answer-first, question-H2, FAQ pattern is already TAG house style for blogs ([SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards)).
- "Rank yourself #1 in your own listicle" is a tactic for software brands; for local service clients a "best X in city" page with self-ranking needs Scott's sign-off and must not make unbacked claims.
- Track AI visibility through [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) LLM visibility data in the [SEO Tracker](lib:brain-seo-tracker).
